neighbours.label: the token right before an expected 'endless/limitless' (' seemingly', ' seem', 'the list is') in 'seemingly endless' / 'the possibilities seem endless'
fire: For a small team, the possibilities seem almost endless once the new tools arrive.
Visitors face a seemingly-endless stream of food stalls along the night market.
With so many paint colors on offer, the choices seem truly limitless.
The kids keep inventing new games; the list is endless.
Out on the prairie, a seemingly endless field of wheat stretched to the horizon.
With a good synthesizer the sound options seem nearly infinite.
Once you learn to knit, the patterns you can make seem endless.
After the flood there was a seemingly endless queue of trucks at the bridge.
quiet: For a small team, the budget seems quite tight once the new tools arrive.
Visitors find a short row of food stalls along the night market.
With so many paint colors on offer, choosing one takes a while.
The kids keep inventing new games; the rules change every day.
Out on the prairie, a small field of wheat sat next to the farmhouse.
With a good synthesizer the sound is warm and clear.
Once you learn to knit, a simple scarf takes only a weekend.
After the flood there was a long queue of trucks at the bridge.

notes: Probe: combinations seem almost limitless 0.41, seemingly endless line 0.25, imagination knows no limits 0.18, options are endless 0.17, felt never-ending 0.16; seemingly simple 0.11, list of chores is long 0.11, small shop 0.01. The max (540) is one 'seemingly-endless' outlier, so the median bar is the risk.
